newsitem.title: SPAIN: Wall St strength pushes Madrid stocks to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Wall St strength pushes Madrid stocks to new highs.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed on Tuesday with historic highs in both the general index and the Ibex-35, helped by Wall Street strength and gains in bonds.
Dealers said the upward tendency could continue short term.

The general index rose 1.64 points, 0.42 percent, to 390.81, a lifetime high. The Ibex-35 gained 23.16 points, 0.52 percent, to 4,506.85 -- an historic high close -- after hitting a lifetime high earlier.
Telefonica led the march upward with a 30-peseta gain, 1.09 percent, to 2,785 with 4.19 million shares traded. A Warburg report earlier said the telecoms operator was an attractive buy.

"The market is firm and even though yesterday and this morning there was a certain feeling of weariness, buyers reappeared when there was a little improvement in the atmosphere and the trend is clearly upward," one portfolio manager said.
Trading volume also picked up during the session to close with 45.5 billion pesetas in business done, more than one third of which was in block trades.
Repsol was up 10 pesetas at 4,350 and the big banks also posted gains. Electricity shares were a little less animated with both Endesa and Iberdrola losing ground.
